spoken_summary: Donald Trump dismisses a reporter's question as "fake news." He tells the reporter to "be quiet" and that they are "second rate." Trump then states, "We're not going to war. We're going to clean up our cities... so they don't kill five people every weekend. That's not war. That's common sense." His comments suggest he is responding to a characterization of his policy towards cities like Chicago as a military action.
